title: Convolution layers and their backward pass
description: Cross-correlation as a sliding dot product with shared weights; stride, padding, channels, output size, im2col and the conv gradients.

title: CNN architectures and residual connections
description: Pooling, receptive fields, and the path from LeNet to ResNet with the identity gradient path of residual blocks.

title: Word embeddings and skip-gram
description: Dense word vectors from context: skip-gram with negative sampling, GloVe and fastText ideas, cosine similarity and analogies.

title: Recurrent networks and BPTT
description: The recurrence h_t = tanh(W_xh x_t + W_hh h_{t-1} + b), unrolling and backpropagation through time with shared-weight gradients.

title: Vanishing and exploding gradients
description: Jacobian products through time, the role of the spectral radius of W_hh, gradient clipping and truncated BPTT.

title: LSTM
description: Input, forget, output gates and candidate; the additive cell-state path, parameter count and backward through one step.

title: GRU
description: Update and reset gates, the leaner gated cell, comparison of parameter counts with LSTM.

title: Sequence-to-sequence models
description: Encoder-decoder, teacher forcing, exposure bias, greedy and beam decoding and the fixed-vector bottleneck.

title: Attention
description: Bahdanau additive attention, alignment weights, masking, and the step to scaled dot-product self-attention.
